name: Hannah Cole

resumeText: As an SDET at Pinecrest Software I own the test automation strategy for our web product suite, building and maintaining end-to-end frameworks with Selenium and Playwright in Python. I integrated automated checks into GitHub Actions so every PR runs the full e2e and API regression suite, cutting release-blocking bugs significantly. I design API-level tests with Postman and pytest to catch regressions early, and I mentor QA testers on reliable automation patterns.
